_about: Vinted US (vinted.com) listing-form catalog for the Thrift Agent. Read from the logged-in sell form APIs on 2026-10-06 (read-only). Covers every leaf under Women/Men clothing, shoes, bags, accessories and Kids Girls/Boys clothing (573 leaves). Only leaf ids can be chosen.

source_apis.attributes_per_category: POST /api/v2/item_upload/attributes body {"attributes":[{"code":"category","value":[<id>]}]} headers Accept, Content-Type, X-CSRF-Token (from page HTML), X-Anon-Id (cookie anon_id)

title.note: plain text; same title rules as Poshmark (brand first, US size)

form.price: USD; buyers pay a Buyer Protection fee on top, seller gets the full price

package_size.type: radio, one of the ids below (offered set depends on category)

package_size_rule: tee/tank/lingerie/kids tops -> X_SMALL if offered else SMALL; jeans, dresses, sweaters, light jackets -> SMALL or MEDIUM by fabric weight; shoes, coats, boots, bags -> MEDIUM; heavy coats/boots -> LARGE.
brand_notes: Brand is optional but pick the exact catalog brand via the brands API. Brands with requires_authenticity_check (e.g. Levi's was flagged) or is_luxury may trigger Vinted's authenticity flow; still list, and note it in the ops report.
